content.text:
The Next.js project is migrated from the Pages Router to the App Router. Summary of changes:

## Migration summary

### 1. App directory structure

- **`app/layout.tsx`** – Root layout with:
  - HTML structure from `_document.tsx` (`<html lang="en">`, `<body>`)
  - Metadata (title, description, favicon, viewport) from `next/head`
  - `metadata` and `viewport` exports for App Router

- **`app/page.tsx`** – Home page with:
  - Same content (h1, paragraph, nav)
  - `Link` from `next/link` instead of `<a href>` for internal routes

### 2. Removed Pages Router files

- `pages/index.tsx`
- `pages/_app.tsx`
- `pages/_document.tsx`
- `pages/` directory

### 3. App Router changes

| Pages Router | App Router |
|--------------|------------|
| `Head` from `next/head` | `metadata` export in layout |
| `_document.tsx` | `layout.tsx` with `<html>`, `<body>` |
| `<a href>` | `Link` from `next/link` |
| `_app.tsx` | Root layout wraps all pages |

The build completed successfully. Run `npm run dev` to start the dev server and `npm run start` for production.
